items.title: 13.3 Gas ka dabao aur PV = (1/3) Nm <v^2> ka husool (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of gas pressure and PV = (1/3)Nm<v^2> (PDF 6-9).

blocks.text: Kinetic theory se aisi equation nikali ja sakti hai jo gas ki macroscopic khasiyaton (dabao aur hajm) ko us ke molecules ki microscopic khasiyaton (kamiyat aur raftar) se jorti hai. Jab gas ke molecules bartan ki deewaron se takrate hain to un par quwwat lagate hain, kyunke har takkar mein un ka momentum badalta hai. Gas ka dabao in takkaron se deewaron par fi ikai raqba quwwat hai. Molecules ki ausat kinetic energy mutlaq darja hararat ke barah-e-raast mutanasib hai, is liye darja hararat barhane se molecules ki raftar barhti, takkarein zyada aur dabao zyada hota hai.

Ideal gas qanoon PV = nRT (13.1) ki pairvi karti hai, jahan P dabao, n moles ki tadaad, T mutlaq darja hararat aur R aam gas constant hai, R = NA kB. Yahan kB = 1.38 x 10^-23 J K^-1 Boltzmann constant aur NA = 6.02 x 10^23 fi mole Avogadro number hai. Kyunke moles ki tadaad n = N/NA hai, jahan N zarrat ki tadaad hai, is liye PV = N kB T (13.2).

items: Kamiyat m wala aik molecule lein jo L side wale cube numa dabbe (Fig 13.2) mein aik satah ki taraf velocity component vx se chal raha hai. Yeh elastic tor par -vx velocity se wapas aata hai, is liye is ke momentum mein tabdeeli dp = -mvx - (mvx) = -2mvx hai.
Yeh usi deewar se do takkaron ke darmiyan 2L faasla tay karta hai, is liye takkaron ke darmiyan waqt t = 2L/vx (13.3) hai.

Newton ke doosre qanoon se molecule par ausat quwwat momentum ki tabdeeli ki sharah hai, aur teesre qanoon se molecule deewar ko barabar aur ulti quwwat se dhakelta hai: F = 2mvx/(2L/vx) = mvx^2/L (13.4).
Deewar ka raqba L^2 hai, is liye is aik molecule ka dabao P = F/L^2 = mvx^2/L^3 = mvx^2/V (13.5) hai, jahan V = L^3.

Tamam molecules ke liye, jin ki raftarein mukhtalif hain, P = (m/V)(v1x^2 + v2x^2 + v3x^2 + ...) (13.6). Khud vx ki ausat sifar hai (aadhe molecules har taraf chalte hain), is liye hum mean square <vx^2> = (v1x^2 + v2x^2 + ... + vNx^2)/N lete hain. Phir P = N m <vx^2> / V. Mean square raftar ka square root root-mean-square (rms) raftar hai (13.8).
Kyunke molecules be-tarteeb chalte hain, teenon simton mein un ki ausat harkat barabar hai: <v^2> = <vx^2> + <vy^2> + <vz^2> = 3<vx^2> (13.9, 13.10), is liye <vx^2> = <v^2>/3 (13.11).

blocks.alt: L side wala cube; teen kinaron par L likha hai aur aik pichhle kone se x, y aur z mehwar (axes) kinaron ke saath chalte hain. Kamiyat m wala molecule velocity v se daen taraf ki rang wali (shaded) deewar ki taraf jata aur -v se wapas aata hai. Molecule se aik dashed lakeer shaded deewar par amood (normal) hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.2: Velocity v se chalta molecule (kitab ki Figure 13.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Density ke lihaz se: gas ki density rho = M/V = mN/V hai, jahan M = mN kul kamiyat hai, is liye dabao ki equation P = (1/3) rho <v^2> (13.14) likhi ja sakti hai. Ise P = (2/3)(N/V)<(1/2)mv^2> = (2/3) No <K.E.> bhi likh sakte hain, jahan No = N/V fi ikai hajm molecules ki tadaad hai.

blocks.title: Equation 13.14
blocks.text: Kitab equation 13.14 ko 'PV = (1/3) rho <v^2>' chhapti hai. Kyunke rho mein hajm pehle se shamil hai (rho = Nm/V), durust shakal P = (1/3) rho <v^2> hai, jo Example 13.1 mein use hui hai.

Aik ideal gas ki density 4.5 kg m^-3, dabao 9.3 x 10^5 Pa aur darja hararat 504 K hai. Gas ke atoms ki root-mean-square raftar maloom karein. Hal: P = (1/3) rho <v^2> se <v^2> = 3P/rho = 3 x (9.3 x 10^5 Pa)/(4.5 kg m^-3) = 6.2 x 10^5 m^2 s^-2. Lehaza v_rms = 6.2 x 10^5 ka square root = 787 m s^-1, taqreeban 7.9 x 10^2 m s^-1.

Kamre ke darja hararat, 25 C, par hawa ke molecules (O2 aur N2) ki rms raftar kya hai? Hal: O2 ki kamiyat 32 u aur N2 ki 28 u hai, 1 u = 1.66 x 10^-27 kg, is liye m(O2) = 5.3 x 10^-26 kg aur m(N2) = 4.6 x 10^-26 kg; T = 298 K aur kB = 1.38 x 10^-23 J K^-1. Oxygen ke liye v_rms = (3 kB T/m) ka square root = (3 x 1.38 x 10^-23 x 298 / 5.3 x 10^-26) ka square root = 481 m s^-1, taqreeban 4.81 x 10^2 m s^-1. Isi tarah nitrogen ke liye v_rms = 515 m s^-1. Hawa ke molecules ki raftar hawa mein awaz ki raftar, taqreeban 340 m s^-1, se kaheen zyada hai.

blocks.prompt: Mole aur Avogadro number mein kya farq hai? Kya Avogadro number maddah ki halat par munhasir hai?
blocks.explanation: Mole maddah ki miqdar hai; Avogadro number (6.02 x 10^23) aik mole mein zarrat ki tadaad hai. Yeh constant hai aur maddah ke thos, maya ya gas hone par munhasir nahi.

blocks.prompt: Kinetic theory Boyle ke qanoon aur Charles ke qanoon ko kaise samjhati hai?
blocks.explanation: PV = (1/3)Nm<v^2> se, jahan <v^2> darja hararat se tay hai: muqarrara T par PV constant hai (Boyle ka qanoon), kyunke kam hajm mein deewar se takkarein zyada hoti hain; muqarrara P par T barhane se <v^2> barhta, is liye V ko T ke tanasub se barhna parta hai (Charles ka qanoon).

items: PV = nRT = N kB T; R = NA kB.
Aik molecule: dp = 2mvx, t = 2L/vx, F = mvx^2/L.
Hawa ke molecules: 25 C par taqreeban 480-515 m s^-1.
